==Description==
'''B''' was an [[Enemies|enemy]] which only appeared in the [[Hidden Wave (Legacy)|Hidden Wave]] and therefore only appeared in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode. As with the other lettered enemies in the game ([[A]] and [[C]]), it appeared after the [[Creator]] spawned.

'''B''' had a high amount of health and fast speed.

==Appearance==
'''B''' had black reflective skin, a white lab coat, and sky blue granite torso and legs. This was similar in appearance to [[A]] and [[C]]. It was about the same size as the [[Abnormal]].

==Strategy==
*Because of its high health, high DPS towers like the [[Turret]], [[Minigunner]], [[Ranger]] and [[Accelerator]], are highly recommended.
**Additionally, [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] should be used to boost said towers.
*Due to '''B's''' fast speed, you should use towers that slow enemies down, like the [[Electroshocker]], [[Sledger]], [[Freezer]], [[Frost Blaster]] or [[Toxic Gunner]].
